tracing_method: Raw HRP at C1-C2 spinal hemisection; 3-day (72-hour) survival; TMB processing; systematic sections.
count_correction: Soma profile counts expanded for section sampling, then C = t/[t + d(1 - e)]; t = 50 µm, e about 15% of d. Abercrombie-type correction, not an unbiased whole-population count.
hemisphere_basis: Dominant hemisphere: ipsilateral for mole and three hedgehogs; contralateral in other retained species. Do not double.
laterality_limit: Non-dominant labeling not an exact projection fraction; hemisection depth and HRP crossing uncontrolled; rock hyrax incomplete hemisection excluded from accepted cohort.
uncertainty_basis: ± retained as printed; no definition of these Results uncertainty terms identified in Methods. Do not label SD or SEM.
anatomical_scope: Region A includes frontal 6 and 4, parietal 3, 1, 2 and 5, with portions of 23/24 in primates; not M1 alone. Region B loosely corresponds to SII and is broader. Region C is primate lateral Area 6; C′ in rodents/lagomorphs is a distinct region, not presumed homologous.
unit_scope: Surface areas in mm² and cells per cortical-surface mm², not volumes or volumetric density. Some reported absolute-area extrema print reciprocal /mm²: retain literal and HOLD without correction.
sample_limit: Per-fact n_individuals unknown; 56 is study context only. Multispecies summaries are not individual or complete species-mean records.
publication_conflicts: Methods says 7 orders, Results says 8; retain both. Region B prints 430 ± 71 cells per mm² and 2.5 ± 8.6 mm² despite internal inconsistencies; no decimal repair.
public_status: WITHHELD: fresh registry codes and owner R/source gates required
collection_overlap: Same Nudo/Masterton experimental lineage; individual overlap not resolved; do not assume independence or identical cohorts.
